Description: Institute of Art, Design and Technology (IADT) Dún Laoghaire is seeking tenders to deliver General Practitioner Services and Medical Administration Support to IADT during term time (32 weeks). (A) General Practitioner Services, Provide a registered and fully qualified GP for up to 11.5 hours per week during term time (32 weeks per annum), comprising: • Three on-campus clinics per week, each of 3 hours 30 minutes (10.5 hours in total); and • Up to 1 hour per week for four off-site appointments at the GP's practice. (B) Medical Administration Support, comprising an on-site Medical Administrator for 26 hours per week for 32 weeks (Monday–Thursday) to manage appointment scheduling, GP–Institute liaison, student support, records compliance, and medical stock control. The service provider has flexibility to timetable the administrator in consultation with the Health Centre Nurse and Student Experience Manager.
